installSimulatorApp.hint: Extract a Simulator-built .app from the IPA; device-only IPA binaries cannot run in Simulator.

installAndroidApk.hint: Select an APK built for the emulator architecture.

installPathRelative.message: Device install path must be absolute
installPathRelative.hint: Supply the full path to the package on this machine.

installPathInvalid.message: Device install path is not valid
installPathInvalid.hint: Supply a path of 1 to 4096 bytes on this machine.

appIdInvalid.message: Device app identifier is not valid
appIdInvalid.hint: Use a bundle id or package name, or package/activity for Android.

appNotLaunchable.message: Android app has no launchable activity
appNotLaunchable.hint: Supply a package/activity component or install the app first.

urlInvalid.hint: Use a URL with a scheme, such as https:// or myapp://.

localeUnsupported.message: Runtime locale configuration is not supported by the installed public CLI contract
localeUnsupported.hint: Change language in the device Settings app, then restart the app.

locationPhysical.message: Only an emulator's location can be set
locationPhysical.hint: Use a mock location app on the device, or set the location on an emulator.

simulatorNotBooted.hint: Boot this Simulator before starting capture.

simulatorNameAmbiguous.message: Booted Simulators have ambiguous display names
simulatorNameAmbiguous.hint: Rename one Simulator or shut down the duplicate before starting capture.

identityPlatformMismatch.message: Device identity does not match its platform

identityNotUdid.message: Simulator identity is not a UDID

identityNotAvd.message: Android device identity is not an AVD name

sizeUndecoded.message: Android display size could not be decoded
sizeUndecoded.hint: Check adb shell wm size on the selected emulator.

iosNeedsMac.message: iOS Simulators need a paired Mac
iosNeedsMac.hint: Pair a Mac running ace in Settings › Fleet and use its Simulators there; agents can delegate that work to the Mac. Android emulators and phones work on this Windows machine.

iosNeedsMacOs.hint: Use a macOS daemon with Xcode installed.

xcodeMissing.hint: Install Xcode and select it with xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer.

xcodeNotFull.message: A full Xcode installation is required
xcodeNotFull.hint: Run xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer, then accept the Xcode license.

adbMissingArm.hint: Install your distribution's adb (Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install adb) to use Android phones and network devices. Android emulators aren't available on Linux arm64.

adbMissingLinux.hint: Install your distribution's adb (Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install adb) for Android phones, or Android Studio's Platform Tools and Android Emulator with ANDROID_HOME set to the SDK directory for emulators too.

sdkMissing.message: Android SDK platform-tools were not found
sdkMissing.hint: Install Android Studio's Platform Tools and Android Emulator, then set ANDROID_HOME to the SDK directory.

androidEmulatorMissing.message: The Android Emulator was not found
androidEmulatorMissing.hint: Install the Android Emulator from Android Studio's SDK Manager, then set ANDROID_HOME to the SDK directory.

androidBootBusy.message: Emulator process limit or boot already in progress
androidBootBusy.hint: Wait for the current boot or shut down another emulator.

toolsNowhere.message: ace has nowhere to keep device tools
toolsNowhere.hint: Restart ace; its home directory should hold them.

armEmulatorNote.message: Android emulators aren't available on Linux arm64
armEmulatorNote.hint: Google publishes the Android Emulator for x86-64 Linux only. Android phones on USB and devices on the network work here through adb.

tooManyTransports.message: Too many Android devices are connected

noPermissions.messageSuffix: is connected, but this user can't open it over USB
noPermissions.hintLinux: Linux needs a udev rule for Android devices: install your distribution's rules (Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install android-udev-rules; Fedora: sudo dnf install android-tools; Arch: sudo pacman -S android-udev), add yourself to the plugdev group (sudo usermod -aG plugdev $USER, then sign out and back in), unplug and replug the device, then run adb kill-server.
noPermissions.hintOther: Unplug and replug the device, then run adb kill-server.

network.hint: On the device, allow the debugging prompt. For wireless debugging, pair first: Developer options > Wireless debugging > Pair device with pairing code, then run adb pair HOST:PORT and adb connect HOST:PORT.

usb.messageSuffix: is waiting for you to allow USB debugging
usb.hint: Unlock the device and tap Allow on the "Allow USB debugging?" prompt. No prompt? Unplug and replug it, or revoke USB debugging authorizations in Developer options and reconnect.

tools.downloadHint: Check the network and download the device tools again from Devices.
tools.againHint: Download the device tools again from Devices.
tools.scrcpyHint: ace downloads scrcpy-server on first use. Check the network, or set ACE_SCRCPY_SERVER to a verified copy.
tools.downloadTimeout: The device tools download took too long
